description: This file defines warning message configurations and extends multiple Odoo models (res.partner, sale.order, purchase.order, account.invoice, stock.picking, product.product, sale.order.line, purchase.order.line) to add warning and blocking message functionalities for various operations involving partners, orders, invoices, stock pickings, and products.

classes.name: res_partner
classes.description: Extends res.partner with warning message fields for sales, purchases, stock, and invoices.

classes.name: sale_order
classes.description: Extends sale.order to add warning logic during partner change.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Extends purchase.order to add warning logic during partner change.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extends account.invoice to add warning logic during partner change.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extends stock.picking to add warning logic during partner change.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Adds warning message fields for sale and purchase order lines.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extends sale.order.line to add warning logic during product change.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Extends purchase.order.line to add warning logic during product change.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Handles warning messages and blocking alerts when partner is changed in sale, purchase, and invoice models.

methods.name: onchange_partner_in
methods.description: Handles warning messages when partner is changed in stock picking.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Handles warning messages when product is changed in sale order line and purchase order line.
